title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Pre-Repossession Compliance Schedule
content:
Compliance schedule for the referral, cure and assignment stage of a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case. The figures are identical across all six collateral classes (Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car through Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van).

| Standard | Value in every class |
|---|---|
| Minimum days past due before a contract is referred for repossession review | 60 |
| Minimum days past due before a right-to-cure notice may be mailed | 10 |
| Months after a cured right-to-cure notice during which a new default may be referred for assignment without another cure notice | 12 |
| How right-to-cure notices are delivered | first-class mail |
| A contract incurred before military service may be repossessed during service only under a court order (50 U.S.C. 3952) | yes |
| A bankruptcy filing on record recalls any assignment immediately (11 U.S.C. 362 automatic stay) | yes |
| The agency must withdraw when the borrower objects at the scene or entry to a closed structure would be needed (UCC 9-609) | yes |
| Calendar days an assignment stays with an agency without a recovery before it is recalled for review | 60 |
| Recovery cases not closed at once for one contract, count | 1 |

## Right-to-cure schedule

The company schedule of contract states whose consumer credit codes require a pre-repossession notice of right to cure, mapped to the cure period in calendar days after mailing (states not listed: no cure notice). The same schedule applies in every class.

| Contract state | Cure period (calendar days after mailing) |
|---|---|
| CO | 20 |
| IA | 20 |
| KS | 20 |
| MA | 21 |
| ME | 14 |
| MO | 20 |
| SC | 20 |
| WI | 15 |
| WV | 10 |

## Reading the schedule

- The state that decides the cure period is the contract state recorded on the Retail Installment Contract.
- A contract whose state does not appear in the table needs no cure notice; for instance (hypothetical contract) a contract written in a state outside the list carries no cure period at all.
